say:3:1220238001:0.female: Oh my! Miss mage! I've been meaning to thank you for your help.

say:4:1220238002:1.text: How was your date? We wanna hear all about it! Seeing your smile, I bet it went well, right?
say:4:1220238002:1.source_cn: 约会怎么样呀？\n不过看安格妮小姐的表情，应该很顺利吧？

say:5:1220238003:0.text: *Giggle* Fador said I looked beautiful and even asked about my perfume. It's all thanks to your magic!
say:5:1220238003:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，法迪夸我特别漂亮，还问我用了什么香水。都是多亏了...

say:6:1220238004:1.text: What perfume? Little lady, you smell like fish!
say:6:1220238004:1.source_cn: 什么香水？你身上一股鱼腥味啊，人类小姑娘。

say:7:1220238005:1.text: Watch your manners, Hugin! You shouldn't talk to girls like that.
say:7:1220238005:1.source_cn: 喂，呼金，不可以对女孩子这样说话呀！

say:8:1220238006:1.text: Haha, it's alright. Rustport's water does have a persistent fishy odor.
say:8:1220238006:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈，没关系的，用锈锚港的水清洁就是会有顽固的鱼腥味……

say:9:1220238007:1.text: Even though you used cleaning magic this time, I'll still need to use the water I've saved for future dates... It's fine, I'm used to it.
say:9:1220238007:1.source_cn: 即使您这次帮我用了清洁魔法，以后的约会还是要用我努力攒...

say:10:1220238008:1.text: Well, our magister could also help with cleaning magic for future dates!
say:10:1220238008:1.source_cn: 咦，下次约会，主人也可以帮您用清洁魔法的呀，安格妮小姐。
say:10:1220238008:1.male: Well, our magister could also help with cleaning magic for future dates!
say:10:1220238008:1.female: Well, our magister could also help with cleaning magic for future dates!

say:11:1220238009:0.text:
Thank you so much.
But I couldn't trouble him every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.
say:11:1220238009:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈，太谢谢您了。\n不过，也不能每次都麻烦魔法师大...
say:11:1220238009:0.male:
Thank you so much.
But I couldn't trouble him every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.
say:11:1220238009:0.female:
Thank you so much.
But I couldn't trouble her every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.

choice_prompt:12:1220238009.text:
Thank you so much.
But I couldn't trouble him every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.

choice_prompt:12:1220238009.male:
Thank you so much.
But I couldn't trouble him every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.
choice_prompt:12:1220238009.female:
Thank you so much.
But I couldn't trouble her every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.

say:13:1220238010:1.text:
What are you on about?!
What can magic fix that clean water can't?!
say:13:1220238010:1.source_cn: 哇嚯，别推来推去的了！\n用干净的水就能解决的事，还靠...

say:14:1220238011:1.text: Wait a moment, little lady. I see a water valve nearby. Let me show you what true craftsmanship looks like!
say:14:1220238011:1.source_cn: 小丫头，你等着，我看这附近有水阀，我这就让你看看，什么...

choice:12:0:1.text: Your dates are important to me.
choice:12:0:1.male: Your dates are important to me.
choice:12:0:1.female: Your dates are important to me.

say:3:1220240001:1.text: The water is so clear, and there's no smell to it!
say:3:1220240001:1.source_cn: 这……这是……这是，水吗？\n这么清澈，一点味道都没有……

say:4:1220240002:0.text: This is amazing! How much does it cost, good sir? I hope I won't have to drain my wallet...
say:4:1220240002:0.source_cn: 这水太棒了！要多少钱呢？我的钱不够吧……？

say:5:1220240003:1.text: Hahaha! Don't worry, this water is free! It's just filtered seawater—take as much as you want!
say:5:1220240003:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！放心吧，这水不贵！都是海水过滤的，要多少有多少！

say:6:1220240004:1.text: Don't hesitate. Use it however you like! From now on, you can use this water anytime you want.
say:6:1220240004:1.source_cn: 别磨蹭了，想用就用吧！以后这些水想怎么用就怎么用！

say:9:1220240005:0.text: Thank you, thank you so much! *Sniffling*
say:9:1220240005:0.source_cn: ……太、太、太感谢您了！太感谢您了！呜呜呜……

say:11:1220240006:0.text: Hey, stop clinging to me! You're crying on my shirt!
say:11:1220240006:0.source_cn: 喂！别扑过来！我的衣服都被你哭脏了！

say:12:1220240007:0.text: Merlin, don't just stand there! Help me out here!
say:12:1220240007:0.source_cn: 喂！梅林，别干看着，帮帮我啊！
say:12:1220240007:0.male: Merlin, don't just stand there! Help me out here!
say:12:1220240007:0.female: Merlin, don't just stand there! Help me out here!

say:14:1220240008:1.text: Hugin's really thoughtful, even if his words are as tough as an anvil.
say:14:1220240008:1.source_cn: 呼金真是体贴啊，就是嘴和铁砧一样硬。

say:15:1220240009:0.text:
S-sorry for losing my composure...
But really, thank you so much!
say:15:1220240009:0.source_cn: 抱、抱歉，我太失态了……\n但是，真的太感谢您了！

say:17:1220240010:0.text: On our last date, Fador actually proposed to me. He said we'll have our wedding ceremony next time he returns...
say:17:1220240010:0.source_cn: 其实，上次的约会，我和法迪订婚了。法迪跟我说，下次他回...

say:18:1220240011:1.text: I wanted to look my best for that day, and at least not smell bad...
say:18:1220240011:1.source_cn: 我一直想在那天打扮得体面一些，至少不要太难闻……

say:19:1220240012:1.text: But I was so worried since with the old water, no matter how much you washed, you'd still smell fishy.
say:19:1220240012:1.source_cn: 我也清楚，用以前那种水，不管怎么洗，身上都会有腥味的。

say:20:1220240013:1.text: But the water here so clean and pure! And it tastes wonderful... *sniffling*
say:20:1220240013:1.source_cn: 但，没想到，现在这些水……不光可以好好洗漱，还能用来喝...

say:21:1220240014:1.text: Miss Angie will definitely be the most beautiful bride in Rustport!
say:21:1220240014:1.source_cn: 安格妮小姐一定会是全锈锚港最漂亮的新娘子的！

say:22:1220240015:1.text: Thank you, little familiar! I'll definitely be the most beautiful bride...
say:22:1220240015:1.source_cn: 是、是的，谢谢你，使魔小姐！我一定会成为最漂亮的新娘……

say:23:1220240016:1.text: It's all thanks to you, Mister Dwarf! You're truly the greatest craftsman in the world!
say:23:1220240016:1.source_cn: 这都是多亏了您，谢谢您，矮人师傅，您真是全世界最最伟大...

say:24:1220240017:1.text: I'll definitely send you an invitation to my wedding!
say:24:1220240017:1.source_cn: 我结婚的时候，一定会给您发请柬！

say:25:1220240018:1.text: Haha! I'll be there for sure!
say:25:1220240018:1.source_cn: 哇哈哈哈哈！好啊！我到时候一定会去的！

say:0:1220241001:0.text: Chippy knows somewhere else that needs a water filter—Golden Guest Inn!
say:0:1220241001:0.source_cn: 还有个地方需要解决水的问题，就是客金旅店！

say:1:1220241002:0.text: Oho! Are you gonna treat me to a drink?
say:1:1220241002:0.source_cn: 哈！难道是要请我喝两杯？

say:0:1220243001:0.text: Oh no. It's those troublemakers again!
say:0:1220243001:0.source_cn: 咦，波尔斯在和上次闹事的混蛋吵架？

say:1:1220244001:0.text: Pull it harder! Yank it off with all your might!

say:5:1220244002:0.text: Heh, this steel pipe is a gem compared to those rusty relics we had before!
say:5:1220244002:0.source_cn: 哈，这根钢管不错，不像前头那几根破烂，全锈坏了！

say:6:1220244003:0.text: A mermaid's hex upon you! You're back trying to steal my pipes again?!

say:7:1220244004:1.text: It's because of you lot that my shop always runs out of water, ain't it? You think I won't feed you to the sharks?!
say:7:1220244004:1.source_cn: 就是你们害我的店老是断水？信不信老子送你们去喂鲨鱼！

say:8:1220244005:1.text: There's a water shortage anyway. The water's foul, no one drinks it!
say:8:1220244005:1.source_cn: 不就是断水吗？反正水又不好喝，根本没人喝水！

say:9:1220244006:1.text: Y-yeah! Drinking ale is fine! Water is pricey and... *hiccup*... tastes terrible...
say:9:1220244006:1.source_cn: 反、反、反正喝酒，喝酒就行了！水……又贵，又，嗝，难喝！

say:12:1220244007:1.text: This pipe's already rusted through. No one would want it even if it's just lying around. What's wrong with us playing with it?
say:12:1220244007:1.source_cn: 你这管子早就烂了，丢路边都没人要……我们拿去玩玩怎么了？

say:13:1220244008:1.text: Are you out of your minds? Do you know who you're talking to?
say:13:1220244008:1.source_cn: 胡言乱语的混蛋，脑子都被酒泡坏了吧，你们知道在和谁说话吗？

say:16:1220244009:1.text: These guys reek of booze. They must've been drinking during the day again...
say:16:1220244009:1.source_cn: 这些家伙身上一股酒气，又在大白天喝酒了吧……

say:17:1220244010:1.text: Ah, I remember you now! The odd bunch with the talking hamsters!
say:17:1220244010:1.source_cn: 啊，我记得你们几个！怪模怪样的家伙和仓鼠！

say:18:1220244011:1.text: I let you off last time because of Walter, but why'd you bring some shorty this time?
say:18:1220244011:1.source_cn: 上回看在沃尔特的面子上饶你们一回，怎么这次又带了个矮子来？

say:21:1220244012:1.text: Shorty? Who are you calling short?! You're going to regret this!
say:21:1220244012:1.source_cn: 矮子？！你说谁矮子呢？！没礼貌的家伙，需要吃点苦头！

say:22:1220244013:1.text: Hmph, perfect time to test out this new pipe I got!
say:22:1220244013:1.source_cn: 哼，正好试试新到手的家伙好不好使！

say:4:1220246002:1.text: We give up. Here, you can take these pipes.
say:4:1220246002:1.source_cn: 打不过，我们认栽，这些管子归你们了。

say:5:1220246003:1.text: Why would we need these pipes?

say:6:1220246004:1.text: Then... if you don't want the pipes, why'd you fight us?
say:6:1220246004:1.source_cn: 不抢水管，你们打我们干嘛？

say:7:1220246005:1.text: To make sure you don't mess with pipes anymore! Rustport's entire water supply depends on them!
say:7:1220246005:1.source_cn: 不许再破坏这些水管了！整个锈锚港的运水和净水系统，就靠...

say:8:1220246006:1.text: Don't you dare come back. If you do, I'll break your legs and toss you into the sea!
say:8:1220246006:1.source_cn: 要是再来，老子打断你们的腿，都丢进海里！

say:9:1220246007:1.text: We're sorry! But the water from these pipes is so pricy and tastes terrible. We don't even drink it anymore, so why do you even need the pipes?
say:9:1220246007:1.source_cn: 我们知错了。但这些水管流出来的水又贵，又不好喝，我们都...

say:12:1220246008:1.text: You fools won't understand. Just know that from now on, the water will taste better!
say:12:1220246008:1.source_cn: 和你们说不通，总之，你们只需要知道，从今以后水会变好喝...

say:13:1220246009:1.text: Yep! This is the Whispers' specialized craftsman. He's testing out the new water filter system. Once it's up and running, everyone in Rustport will have clean, tasty water!
say:13:1220246009:1.source_cn: 对，看见没，这位是索尼娅和卢卡委托的净水系统改造工匠，...

say:16:1220246010:1.text: Whether it's for cooking, drinking, or washing! You can use it for anything.
say:16:1220246010:1.source_cn: 是的，不管是喝，还是做饭，还是洗漱，都可以随便用！

say:17:1220246011:1.text: What? Stop daydreaming. Luck like that doesn't happen to people in Rustport!
say:17:1220246011:1.source_cn: 啊？你们说什么呢，别做梦了，哪有那种好事？

say:18:1220246012:1.text: Wow! You must still be drunk. Keep dreaming if you want! Just watch what we can do.
say:18:1220246012:1.source_cn: 嚯！看样子酒还没醒呢，是不是做梦就瞧着吧！

say:19:1220246013:1.text: Merlin, let's get this filtration device installed and wake these idiots up!
say:19:1220246013:1.source_cn: 梅林，我们先去把滤水装置装上，让这帮混蛋醒醒酒！
say:19:1220246013:1.male: Merlin, let's get this filtration device installed and wake these idiots up!
say:19:1220246013:1.female: Merlin, let's get this filtration device installed and wake these idiots up!

say:0:1220247001:0.source_cn: 让我们来接上滤水装置吧！

say:1:1220248001:0.text: Is this... water? It's so clean... I've never seen water this pure!
say:1:1220248001:0.source_cn: 是……水？好干净……我从没见过这么干净的水！

say:5:1220248003:0.text: No way, I haven't had enough yet!

say:7:1220248004:0.text: So it's actually true. Clean water with a hint of sweetness. I'm not dreaming!
say:7:1220248004:0.source_cn: 竟然是真的，干净的，还带点甜味的水！我真的不是在做梦！

say:11:1220248006:0.text: Wait a second... You're Hugin, from the Century Forge?! I've seen you from afar!
say:11:1220248006:0.source_cn: 咦？你是百炼工坊的呼金？！我远远望见过你的脸！

say:12:1220248007:0.text: Ah, I recognize you too. *Hiccup* It's Hugin! He even fixed my gun once!
say:12:1220248007:0.source_cn: 啊啊，我、我也认得，嗝，是、是呼金！他还帮我修好过枪！

say:13:1220248008:1.text: This is incredible, thank you so much!
say:13:1220248008:1.source_cn: 太、太、太好了，太感谢您了！

say:14:1220248009:1.text: Whoa, why are you crying all of a sudden?
say:14:1220248009:1.source_cn: 嚯，好好的小伙子怎么说着说着就哭了呢……？

say:15:1220248010:1.text: We know drinking's bad! Walter's told us so many times, but we had nothing else to drink...
say:15:1220248010:1.source_cn: 我们也知道喝酒不好！沃尔特那家伙劝了我们好多次，但我们...

say:16:1220248011:1.text: If we had proper water, we wouldn't have to... *hiccup*... get drunk every day!
say:16:1220248011:1.source_cn: 如果真能有水用，我们就不用再……嗝！每天醉醺醺的了！

say:17:1220248012:1.text: How about this? We'll buy you a drink!
say:17:1220248012:1.source_cn: 要、要不，我们请您也喝一杯！

say:20:1220248013:1.text: We'll treat you to a drink, the most expensive one, and we promise we'll quit drinking from now on!
say:20:1220248013:1.source_cn: 是，我们请您喝吧，喝最贵的，我们以后绝对戒酒了！！

say:21:1220248014:1.text: Ha! You lot need to quit drinking! And save some coin for yourselves!
say:21:1220248014:1.source_cn: 嚯，戒酒是好事哇！你们那点钱自己留着吧！

say:22:1220248015:1.text:
Yes, sir!
Let's go gather all the pipes we've got and return them.
say:22:1220248015:1.source_cn: 是是是，都听您的！\n哥们几个，走，把家里的管子都找出...

say:26:1220248016:0.text: How many pipes did you even steal...?
say:26:1220248016:0.source_cn: 嚯，这帮人到底偷了多少管子啊……？

choice_prompt:27:1220248016.text: How many pipes did you even steal...?
choice_prompt:27:1220248016.source_cn: 嚯，这帮人到底偷了多少管子啊……？

say:28:1220248017:1.text: Me? Well... It's hard to put into words.
say:28:1220248017:1.source_cn: 感想？感想就是……唉，不知道怎么说……
say:28:1220248017:1.male: Me? Well... It's hard to put into words.
say:28:1220248017:1.female: Me? Well... It's hard to put into words.

say:29:1220248020:1.text: Let's call it a day. I have some... things to do, let's meet at Sonja's tomorrow morning.
say:29:1220248020:1.source_cn: 今天就到这吧，我还有点私事要处理，明早在索尼娅办公的地方见。

say:32:1220248022:0.text: Why is Hugin being so mysterious? What's he up to?
say:32:1220248022:0.source_cn: 呼金怎么神神秘秘的，他在锈锚港还能有什么私事处理？

choice_prompt:33:1220248022.text: Why is Hugin being so mysterious? What's he up to?
choice_prompt:33:1220248022.source_cn: 呼金怎么神神秘秘的，他在锈锚港还能有什么私事处理？

say:34:1220248023:1.text: Anyway, we'll be meeting him at Sonja's office tomorrow! Let's wait and see!
say:34:1220248023:1.source_cn: 嗯，反正明天还会在索尼娅的办公室见面！那就等等吧！

say:36:1220248018:1.text: Haha, of course! Hugin, the world's greatest craftsman, strikes again!
say:36:1220248018:1.male: Haha, of course! Hugin, the world's greatest craftsman, strikes again!
say:36:1220248018:1.female: Haha, of course! Hugin, the world's greatest craftsman, strikes again!

choice:27:1:2.text: Seems like the filter works great.
choice:27:1:2.male: Seems like the filter works great.
choice:27:1:2.female: Seems like the filter works great.

say:37:1220248019:1.text: Hey, I can hear that joking tone in your voice. Don't tease me!
say:37:1220248019:1.source_cn: 嚯，别笑话我啦！还早着呢！
say:37:1220248019:1.male: Hey, I can hear that joking tone in your voice. Don't tease me!
say:37:1220248019:1.female: Hey, I can hear that joking tone in your voice. Don't tease me!

say:0:1220249001:0.text: We successfully convinced Hugin to stay in Rustport, right?
say:0:1220249001:0.source_cn: 呼金应该打消离开锈锚港的念头了吧？

say:3:1220251001:0.text:
You finally arrived.
Look at this!
say:3:1220251001:0.source_cn: 你们总算来了，\n喏，看看这个！

say:5:1220251002:0.text: ... Is this a map of the waterways of Rustport? With changes and adjustments?
say:5:1220251002:0.source_cn: 这，这是……这是锈锚港的水路规划图？而且还有改动和调整……

say:7:1220251003:0.text: Yesterday, Hugin asked me for the old waterway design map out of the blue. Luckily, there was a copy in Tesio's desk.
say:7:1220251003:0.source_cn: 昨天呼金突然来找我要旧的水路设计图，还好泰西欧的桌子里...

say:8:1220251004:1.text: He took it and left, and came back this morning with an updated map.
say:8:1220251004:1.source_cn: 拿到手他就走了，说是要对照什么，今天早上才回来。然后就...

choice_prompt:9:1220251004.text: He took it and left, and came back this morning with an updated map.
choice_prompt:9:1220251004.source_cn: 拿到手他就走了，说是要对照什么，今天早上才回来。然后就拿出了这张规划图。

say:11:1220251006:1.text: When it was first designed, the conditions were very different. Updating it to fit the current needs was no small feat...
say:11:1220251006:1.source_cn: 当年人类佬设计的时候，海水和居民情况和现在完全不同。要...

say:12:1220251007:1.text:
Well done, Hugin.
With this blueprint and your filtration device, Rustport will have access to clean, fresh water for everyone.
say:12:1220251007:1.source_cn: 干得太漂亮了，呼金。\n只要有这份线路图和你发明的滤水...

Hehe, don't thank me.

say:13:1220251008:1.source_cn: 哇哈哈哈……不用谢我。\n一定要谢的话，就谢<styl...

Hehe, don't thank me.

say:13:1220251008:1.female:
Hehe, don't thank me.
If you want to thank someone, thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
